introText.en: Paper 3 is the HL extended investigation paper (75 min · 55 marks · GDC required). It consists of 2 compulsory extended problem-solving questions (25–30 marks each) assessing inquiry, generalization, proof, and modelling.

resourceCards.title: HL Formula Booklet
resourceCards.body: More extensive than SL; includes series, complex number forms, vector formulae, and distribution tables.

resourceCards.title: AA HL Past Papers
resourceCards.body: Available 2019–present (new syllabus). Focus on proof questions, calculus, complex numbers, and vectors.

resourceCards.title: AI HL Past Papers
resourceCards.body: Available 2021–present. Focus on statistics, modelling, matrices, and network problems.

resourceCards.title: Paper 3 Preparation
resourceCards.body: Practice with past Paper 3 questions; focus on mathematical communication and justification. Typically 2 questions, each 25–30 marks.
